layout_and_architecture.landing_hero: Cinematic Intro Splash with 'ENTER THE QUEST' animated prompt, Narrator Akash voice waveform greeting, sound toggle, & quest stats.
layout_and_architecture.rpg_world_map: 4 Level Cards (Interactive RPG Quest Hub with Locked/Unlocked/Completed states, status badges, difficulty meters, & completion progress 0-100%).
layout_and_architecture.audio_player_hud: Fixed top/bottom Audio Narration bar with Web Audio waveform visualizer, dynamic subtitles/captions, play/pause/replay/mute, & speed controls.
layout_and_architecture.voice_input_hud: Wispr Flow compatible dictation bar with live audio visualizer, mic pulse indicator, fallback typing input, & voice command shortcuts ('SELECT POKEMON', 'ALLOCATE CHAKRA', 'LAUNCH CAMPAIGN').
layout_and_architecture.persistent_nav: Header with '4/4 SPACES UNLOCKED' progress counter, fast-travel level links, reset quest option, & downloadable resume action.
layout_and_architecture.quest_completed_modal: Victory Kamehameha celebration sequence, unlocked full portfolio view, and direct CTA to book interview / connect with Akash.

level_1_swiper_challenge.name: Level 1: The Origin Space / Swiper's Challenge
level_1_swiper_challenge.gameplay: Voice-shouting & fast dictation challenge. Swipe away 'Swiper the Growth Thief' by dictating / typing growth mantras ('Swiper No Swiping', 'Growth Mindset', 'Wispr Flow Speed').
level_1_swiper_challenge.unlocks_portfolio_section: Know Me (Akash's Bio, Mission Statement, Early Foundations & Growth DNA)

level_2_pokemon_arena.name: Level 2: The Builder's Arena / Prof Oak's Academy
level_2_pokemon_arena.gameplay: Turn-based RPG battle engine. Select 1 of 6 Akash Growth Pokemon (e.g., 'Viral-izard', 'Funnel-dactyl', 'Retention-ite') vs opponent 'Churn-Monster' or 'Stagnant-Bot'. Choose moves ('A/B Blitz', 'Hook Cannon', 'SEO Surge', 'Retention Shield').
level_2_pokemon_arena.unlocks_portfolio_section: Explore My Builds (5 Live Projects Showcase with interactive cards, tech stack tags, metrics & demo links)

level_3_mind_dungeon.name: Level 3: The Mind Dungeon / Shinobi Strategy Trial
level_3_mind_dungeon.gameplay: Strategic resource allocation with Chakra Points (100 Chakra Budget). Complete 3 ninja trials: Jutsu 1 (User Acquisition Strategy), Jutsu 2 (Product Positioning), Jutsu 3 (Growth Loop Mechanics).
level_3_mind_dungeon.unlocks_portfolio_section: Understand My Mind (Strategic Mental Models, Thinking Flowcharts, First-Principles Framework)

level_4_growth_kingdom.name: Level 4: The Growth Kingdom / The 100K Kamehameha
level_4_growth_kingdom.theme: DBZ Super Saiyan Growth Marketing Simulator
level_4_growth_kingdom.gameplay: Growth marketing simulation. Allocate $100K budget across Paid Ads, Influencer Blitz, Product-Led Loops, and Viral Content. Power up Kamehameha meter to 100K Users & score pitch evaluation.
level_4_growth_kingdom.unlocks_portfolio_section: Play Growth Hacker (Interactive Wispr Flow Growth Campaign Proposal & Growth Simulator Sandbox)

sound_effects_and_audio.synthesizer: Use Web Audio API oscillator fallback for retro 8-bit game SFX (win chord, button click, level up chime, damage blast, Kamehameha wave).
sound_effects_and_audio.speech_narration: Web Speech API (window.speechSynthesis) and HTML5 Audio elements with Akash narrator voice lines for intro, level briefing, win state, and advice.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a voice-first, high-interactivity anime RPG website. Ensure it feels like a legitimate game experience rather than a basic template with gaming widgets.
Ensure all level states (locked/unlocked/completed) synchronize with localStorage so refreshing maintains progress.
Provide fallback keyboard typing controls alongside SpeechRecognition dictation for instant testing.
Use framer-motion for smooth turn-based animations, attack particle bursts, level-up cards, and Kamehameha energy beam expansion.
Ensure strict compliance with data-testid attributes across all interactive components.
